methods.intent: Successful candidate plus independent verification of identical head appends verified identity and publish=true; unequal heads deny publication.
Skipped/missing verification and absent verified output fields reject with existing output bytes preserved.
Unchanged candidate success with green required; false green or failed/skipped/cancelled job denies; success appends nothing.
Historical selected source must be unchanged, successful and match exact candidate head; wrong head/changed source reject, accepted source never publishes.
Approved certify=false skip succeeds without candidate/verification green or GITHUB_OUTPUT and appends nothing.
Failed preflight rejects as environment preflight failure before evaluating candidate, retaining original output bytes.
